title: A witness with a stake in the story
literal_meaning: The liquor seller’s witness is the drunk!
explanation: The supposed witness has a connection to the person being defended. The pointed question is whether that testimony is independent.
meaning_odia: ଯାହାଙ୍କୁ ସାକ୍ଷୀ କରାଯାଉଛି, ସେ ନିଜେ ସେହି କାମରେ ଜଡ଼ିତ—ଏହି ଅସୁବିଧାକୁ କଥାଟି ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ କରେ। ଏକା ସ୍ୱାର୍ଥ ଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କ କଥାକୁ ସ୍ୱାଧୀନ ପ୍ରମାଣ ଭାବେ ନେବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ବିଚାର ଦରକାର। ଏହା ସାକ୍ଷ୍ୟର ସମ୍ପର୍କ ବିଷୟରେ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ, କୌଣସି ପେଶାର ସବୁ ଲୋକ ଅସତ୍ୟ କହନ୍ତି ବୋଲି ଦାବି ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: A seller cites only their business partner as proof of a product’s quality. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The occupational caricature is not evidence about any community’s honesty. Shared interests invite scrutiny, not automatic disbelief.

witnesses.note: Original licensed page inspected; new editorial translations and explanations, not collected oral testimony.

variants.note: Related alternate expression grouped editorially with the liquor seller/drunkard witness saying; here the figures are curd and flattened-rice sellers. No established textual descent. Literal: The flattened-rice seller is witness for the curd seller. ଅର୍ଥ: ଦହି ବିକ୍ରେତାଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଚୂଡ଼ା ବିକ୍ରେତା ସାକ୍ଷୀ ହେଉଛନ୍ତି। ଆମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ, ପରସ୍ପର ସମ୍ପର୍କିତ ସ୍ୱାର୍ଥ ଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କ ସାକ୍ଷ୍ୟ କେତେ ନିରପେକ୍ଷ, ସେହି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଏଠାରେ ଉଠୁଛି। ଏହା ସେମାନେ ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ମିଛ କହୁଛନ୍ତି ବୋଲି ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ। Explanation: Read editorially, the paired sellers suggest connected interests, so the independence of the witness deserves scrutiny. The source names a witness relationship, not an actual lie or conspiracy. The food pairing supplies the connection; no particular partnership or transaction is specified. odia_summary: ଯାହାଙ୍କ ସପକ୍ଷରେ ସାକ୍ଷୀ ଦିଆଯାଉଛି, ସାକ୍ଷୀଙ୍କର ତାଙ୍କ ସହ ସ୍ୱାର୍ଥ ଜଡ଼ିତ; ତେଣୁ ନିରପେକ୍ଷତା ନେଇ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଉଠେ।
english_summary: A witness with an interest in the outcome may not offer independent testimony.
